Date: 2027-10-03T07:12:00-07:00
Subject: Checkout errors + high latency in us-west AZ3 (urgent)

Hi Aisha,

We're seeing a sharp increase in checkout failures since 06:50 PT — p50 latency up ~3x, p99 from 450ms -> 1.8s, and a 5xx "gateway_error" rate of 2.4% for transactions routed through us-west AZ3. This started coincident with a deploy on our side, but after routing around our nodes the errors persist. Impact: ~7% order drop rate in last 20m, affecting multiple stores.

Can Redwood confirm whether US-WEST AZ3 is experiencing incidence? We need a mitigation plan and ETA. Attaching sample errors and a short csv of request ids.

Thanks,
Liam Porter
SRE, Nimbus Retail

Subject: Fwd: Checkout errors + high latency in us-west AZ3 (urgent)

Folks — forwarding an urgent SRE report from Nimbus Retail. TL;DR: p99 latency and gateway 5xxs concentrated on us-west AZ3. Nimbus is seeing checkout failures that correlate with our edge routing through AZ3 (traffic shard ~18%).

Initial triage steps I'm taking:
- Confirm infra metrics for us-west AZ3 (latency, packet drops, host OOM)
- Look at ingress throttling and circuit-breaker tripping on the routing tier
- Spin a canary fanout: temporarily route 20% of AZ3 traffic to us-east2 via global-edge; monitor errors + SSEs

Requests:
- Ben: prepare the fanout plan and rate-limit override for the edge gateway.
- Marissa: I'm going to draft a customer status note; will need a one-line exec blurb for leadership.
- Neha: pull SOC logs and any recent kernel/driver updates for AZ3 hosts.
- Priyom: check billing/contract constraints for cross-region redirection, customers may ask for credits.

Attachments I'm including locally: runbook_snapshot.txt, current p99 chart.

Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

[attachment: p99-latency.png (png)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.inference, marissa.cole@redwood.inference, neha.kapoor@redwood.inference, priyom.das@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-10-03T07:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Checkout errors + high latency in us-west AZ3 (urgent)

On it. Engineering is preparing a controlled fanout plan:
- Step 1 (07:40): Canary 5% -> us-east-2 (validate checkout trace ids)
- Step 2 (07:50): If canary stable, expand to 20%, with dynamic token-bucket limit at 100 rps per shard
- Step 3: If errors fall <0.3% for 10m, promote as failover until full remediation

I'll post the route update and rollback tokens in #ops. Expecting minimal infra changes; mostly routing config. Will attach the route snippet once pushed.

Ben
Lead SRE
[attachment: route-change-snippet.txt (txt)]

Date: 2027-10-03T07:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout errors + high latency in us-west AZ3 — immediate actions

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the report and the logs — we have engineering running a controlled edge fanout now. Current status:
- 07:40 PT: 5% of AZ3-bound traffic redirected to US-EAST-2 (canary)
- 07:52 PT: Canary passing, error rate down to 0.45% overall; still above baseline
- 08:00 PT: Expanded to 20% traffic; observed decrease in order drop rate to ~1.2%

Next steps: We'll keep the controlled fanout in place while the remediation team investigates host-level causes in AZ3. Our SREs are also applying a temporary token-bucket throttle to protect checkout latency.

We understand this is disruptive — Aisha will coordinate customer comms and any contractual remediation. I'll keep you posted every 30 minutes.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference
